messages:
mari: Heads up  AuroraCloud integration + marketplace listing target launch two weeks out. Scope: marketplace tile, joint 45m webinar (20m product sync + 20m demo + 5m Q&A), co-auth blog + one-pager. Need routing for inbound leads and separate email flows for devs vs platform buyers. Who owns what? :calendar:

tanya: I can take the webinar landing page + registration emails. Will draft two variants (devs / platform). ETA: Tue noon PT for draft.

kevin: I'll own marketplace metadata and the tile assets. Need final logo SVG and 50-100 word blurb by Mon. Also confirm redirect CTA target (our reg page vs marketplace native capture).

ash: Im on routing and tracking. Proposal: send all leads through Segment, then into Salesforce with lead.source = marketplace|webinar and lead.partner = auroracloud. Also recommend utm_campaign=aurora_integration_2025 and utm_medium=marketplace|email.

mari: Good. @ash please post the SF workflow skeleton. @kevin we prefer redirect to our page for better tracking unless marketplace forces native capture.

ash: Draft workflow snippet:

```json
{
  "workflow_id":"aurora_inbound_routing",
  "match":{
    "utm_campaign":"aurora_integration_2025",
    "utm_medium":["marketplace","email","webinar"]
  },
  "actions":[
    {"create_lead_in":"Salesforce"},
    {"set_field":{"lead.partner":"auroracloud","lead.origin":"marketplace_or_webinar"}},
    {"assign":"growth-rm-queue"}
  ]
}
```

ash: I'll add lead scoring rules and SLA for MQL assignment.

kevin: For the marketplace tile, we need 3 hero images (1200x600), a short tagline, and the CTA URL. Will mock up tomorrow.

tanya: Webinar promo timeline: 3 waves of email (announce, reminder, last chance). Also 2 x social cards. Drafts by Tue.

mari: Blog: co-auth outline and key messaging points below. @tanya @kevin please review and flag anything missing.

ash: One integration note: to support trial provisioning in demo, we need an API token from Aurora team. Can someone follow up?

kevin: Reaching out to Aurora PM now. Will loop their eng and request sandbox credentials.

mari: Tracking checklist: UTMs  utm_source=aurora_marketplace|aurora_email|aurora_webinar, utm_campaign=aurora_integration_2025, utm_content=tile|card|email_variant. Also ensure GA goal for signup and Segment event 'aurora_registrant'.

ash: Adding property mapping: contact.partner = auroracloud, contact.entry_point = marketplace|webinar, contact.utm = full querystring. Will share mapping doc.

webhook-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot reserved 2025-10-14 16:00 UTC. Meeting created.

tanya: Quick Q  do we want separate registration pages for dev vs platform or a single page with audience segmentation? Pros/cons?

mari: Let's ship a single page with audience selector on the form (radio button). Pass selection as contact.audience and route to different nurture streams. Simpler for marketplace CTA.

ash: Agree. I'll wire up routing to pick nurture stream based on contact.audience.

kevin: FYI marketplace requires a 300-char description and a feature bullet list. Draft incoming.

tanya: I'll prep copy blocks for both audiences and two email subject variants.

mari: Solid. Weekly check-ins Wed 10am PT until launch. Flag blockers here. Thanks team :thumbsup:
